FN-TECH591-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 295
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Security
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/18/2024
House Bill 295 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Human Resources to adopt rules to implement the provisions of this bill. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
